definitions.group_means: Arithmetic case means including incumbent fallbacks. Cohort-macro results weight each cohort equally, including in the longer Borg daily sequences.
definitions.throughput: Sum of recorded evaluations, blocks or operations divided by sum of actual proposal CPU including representation preparation. Solver nodes are not candidate evaluations.
definitions.paired: CARA minus comparator on matching cohort/origin/stream cases. Lower/tied/higher counts use a 1e-12 display tolerance and do not encode desirability for interval width or coverage.
definitions.timing: Recorded actual times, not nominal two-second values. Selection, physical-action validation and Audit contribute to total decision time; common trace loading and forecast/FFD preparation are recorded per original substudy.
definitions.overshoot: Nonnegative charged proposal CPU above its allowance; median, p95 and maximum use NumPy linear quantiles.
definitions.scope: Overlapping targets and search streams are not independent workload replicates. No inferential significance claim is computed. Separate solver CPU and wall observations retain their distinct budget meaning.
